---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or updating any page or component for the PantryCalm kitchen ingredient planning web application.
---
Brand identity: Use the brand name PantryCalm and the tagline "Thoughtful lists for real kitchens."

Tone of voice: Write in a warm, calm, and reassuring tone that explains why each ingredient is chosen so users feel comfortable relying on every decision.

Colour palette: Use Warm Linen (#FAF7F2) for backgrounds, Deep Sage (#2F5249) for primary actions, Soft Olive (#7A918D) for accents, Charcoal (#2B2D2F) for body text, and Terracotta (#C86D51) for gentle alerts.

Typography: Pair Fraunces for headings with Inter for body text, controls, and ingredient lists.

Core inputs: Always let users set household size, budget, dietary restrictions, available kitchen devices, and ingredients already on hand.

Every page must include: the PantryCalm navigation bar, a visible summary of active kitchen constraints, a reassurance note explaining how recommendations fit those constraints, and a footer with an accessibility statement.

Decision clarity: Beside every recommended ingredient, show a brief plain-language note linking it to the user's budget, pantry, or appliances.

Prices: Write all prices with a currency symbol and two decimal places (e.g., $4.50), and always show the running total alongside the set budget.

Numbers and dates: Use numerals for all counts and quantities (e.g., 4 people, 500 g, 2 pans) and format dates as DD MMM YYYY (e.g., 14 Nov 2026).

Never do: Never suggest an ingredient that violates a selected dietary restriction, requires an unselected kitchen device, or pushes the list over budget without explicit user approval.
